objective: Test a frozen covariant gravity action by predicting untouched Solar-System timing, coherent-frequency, and angular records from training-only state estimates and audited instrument calibration, without using fitted PPN or gravity-model residual labels as truth.

examples: station clock counter readings and transmit/receive event tags
detector pixels or interferometric fringe observables
instrument housekeeping and weather records used by calibration
coherent carrier-frequency ratios with oscillator provenance
calibrated angular separations with plate or baseline covariance
antenna and propagation calibration terms with uncertainty
round-trip light-time from paired clock events
relative angular position within one observing session
derived.rule: Every derived quantity retains its raw inputs, exact transformation, calibration parameters, full covariance, and assumptions.

examples: ephemeris state estimated with a chosen gravity model
precomputed Shapiro, perihelion, or light-deflection residual

inputs: clock-tagged transmitted and received radio or radar events with station and oscillator provenance
coherent carrier phase or frequency counts with integration interval and cycle-slip audit
calibrated optical or radio angular measurements with detector, plate, or interferometric-baseline provenance
instrument, tropospheric, ionospheric, plasma, and station calibration records with covariance
training-only initial-condition measurements and their covariance
prediction_targets: held-out coherent carrier frequency-count or phase-ratio records
allowed_formula_inputs: audited measurement-channel inputs available before the test session
one frozen covariant action and universal constants
training-only frozen state estimates with uncertainty
globally frozen instrument and propagation calibration nuisances
forbidden_formula_inputs: precomputed Shapiro, perihelion, or light-deflection residual labeled by a gravity model
ephemeris state or residual estimated using held-out target records
GR-derived correction or post-fit anomaly treated as truth
object-specific gravitational coupling or screening parameter
measurement_channel.initial_state_rule: Initial conditions and nuisance posteriors use training sessions only, are frozen with uncertainty before held-out sessions open, and cannot be refitted to held-out targets.

split_contract.stratification_inputs: instrument, geometry class, and measurement quality fixed before target opening; no gravity-model residual or fitted PPN label
split_contract.sealed_test_rule: Test-session identities, signals, and residuals remain inaccessible until the action hash, universal constants, initial state and covariance, calibration model, likelihood, and stopping rule are frozen.

scoring_contract.fit_term: joint held-out likelihood in direct signal space using measurement, clock, propagation, and calibration covariance
scoring_contract.complexity_term: preregistered action description length and universal-parameter count
required_baselines: the same signal model under the frozen Einstein-Hilbert reference action
an instrument-null or no-gravity-perturbation diagnostic that cannot serve as physical truth
scoring_contract.selection_rule: Action and nuisance selection uses training and validation sessions only; no test signal or residual is used before the complete freeze.

prohibited_truth_or_rescue: post-hoc initial-state or calibration refit chosen to rescue a failed action
opening_requirements: all required theory-side formal gates pass for the exact action hash
the observational evidence policy hash is frozen
the direct-observation dataset manifest and raw-to-calibrated transformations pass an independent audit
tracking-session group splits are hash-committed before any test target opens
training-only initial states, calibration hierarchy, covariance, and propagation corrections are frozen
the likelihood, complexity penalty, baselines, and stopping rule are preregistered
